title: Bluesky wants to give you your own domain on the open web
slides: Bluesky wants to hand you a domain — but why?
Your handle could become your actual website address
Most users still don't control their online identity
Sign up now to claim yours before squatters do
Own your name or rent it forever?
thread_text:
1. Your handle just became real estate

Bluesky now hands you a domain for free. Your @name can resolve as an actual web address, no registrar needed.

2. Why is a social app giving away domains?

Because whoever controls your handle controls your identity. Bluesky is betting that ownership keeps you locked in — not ads.

3. Most people are still renting their name

On other platforms, your handle is a lease. The company can revoke it, rename you, or sell your reach overnight.

4. Squatters are already circling

Early claimers lock in the good names. Late arrivals get leftovers — or pay a premium to whoever grabbed theirs first.

5. Go claim your name today

Sign in to Bluesky, open settings, and set your handle as a domain before someone else does. Did you already check if yours is taken?

instagram.caption:
Your @handle on Bluesky can now double as a real web address you actually own.

Bluesky started handing users their own domain for free — no registrar, no fees.

It works because whoever controls your handle controls your identity, and the app is betting ownership keeps you around.

Everywhere else your name is just a lease the platform can revoke or sell overnight.

If you publish anything under a handle, you already know your audience finds you there — lose it and you lose the link.

Squatters are grabbing good names first, so early claimers win.

Check settings today: is yours still available? 🔍
